Property Record Review & Setup

Audit your existing property records and set up a compliant documentation system for leases, tenants, payments, and notices.

Why You Need This Service

Many landlords don't have a system for organizing property records. Documents are scattered — some in a drawer, some on phone notes, some lost. When you need to find a lease or prove something happened, you can't.

This service creates order. We:

  • Audit what you currently have and what's missing
  • Design a system for organizing property records
  • Create templates for documents you need going forward
  • Show you how to maintain the system
  • Give you tools to stay compliant

From chaos to clarity, in one project.

What We Review & Set Up

  • Existing Records: Gather what you have on each property and tenant
  • Gaps Analysis: What's missing or incomplete
  • Organization System: Folder structure (physical or digital) for all documents
  • Tenant File: What should be in each tenant's file
  • Payment Records: How to track and document rent received
  • Lease Register: Master list of all leases with key dates
  • Notice System: How to document notices served to tenants
  • Maintenance Log: Tracking repairs and tenant requests

What You Get

  • Audit Report: What you have, what's missing, what's at risk
  • Organization Plan: Physical/digital system design for your records
  • Document Templates: Lease register, tenant file checklist, payment log
  • Procedure Manual: Step-by-step how to maintain the system
  • Compliance Checklist: What to collect and keep for each tenant
  • Training: How to use the system going forward

When You Need This Service

  • You manage multiple properties and documents are disorganized
  • You're taking over management from someone else
  • You can't easily find tenant information when you need it
  • You've had disputes and realized your records are weak
  • You want to be ready if Rent Control asks for documentation

The Payoff

Clean, organized records take a few hours to set up but save you days of searching, mistakes, and disputes. If you ever need to prove something in Rent Control, this system is your advantage.
